title: Global Inventory Synchronization for Retail
business: Global retail chains managing stock levels across multiple continents.
problem: High latency in regional database updates leads to inventory overselling during peak traffic.
solution: Azure Cosmos DB provides globally distributed multi-model NoSQL APIs with tunable consistency, allowing the application to replicate inventory state across regions while selecting the appropriate consistency level to balance performance and data accuracy.
steps: Provision an Azure Cosmos DB account with multi-region write capabilities enabled.
Define the partition key based on product categories to ensure horizontal scalability.
Configure the consistency level to Session or Bounded Staleness based on regional requirements.
Implement application logic to handle cross-region data synchronization via the SDK.
outcome: Improved user experience through reduced latency for regional read/write operations and consistent inventory visibility.
limitation: Choosing a weaker consistency level can lead to temporary data staleness; developers must verify the consistency requirements per operation to ensure business logic remains valid.
